Synopsis:
The dialog for the alarm system. If the player activates it then the first half of the camp will become hostile.

Cluster Contexts:
- GOB_BattleStations_WarDrum.json: There’s a large warning drum here — an alarm meant to summon or rally the camp; the narration points out it can be heard for miles and the player can strike it. Off-screen, a group of children recently burst in shouting that Helia, a bear kept nearby, broke free and that the goblin guards in the pens were found slaughtered (apparently by a werewolf), after which the kids fled. Containment and defenses around the pens have been breached and the bear is loose. If the player hits the drum, it will sound the alarm and (per the synopsis) cause the first half of the camp to become hostile.
- INT_EmperorRevealed_WokenUpAtNight_SCO.json: The players are woken up by the booming voice of the Absolute becoming unbearable. The artefact struggles and eventually shines bright, opening a portal (seen in gameplay) to the Astral Plane. GROUP_Players in SpeakerGroup1 is the active player.
- UND_DuergarRaftCaptain_Camp.json: Default dialog for the captain of the raft at the duergar camp. In default state, he encourages you to talk to the sergeant, as he has already told you to do that in previous dialogue.
- WYR_RefugeeCamp_FlamingFist_001.json: A short dialog for the flaming fist guarding a back door of the Big Barn which holds donations for the refugees. Same dialog will be used in a case of this flaming fist catching the player inside the barn.

Dialogue Excerpts (up to 3 samples, ordered):
Sample 1:
- Narrator: *The drum sits in silence.* (node 5)
- Narrator: *This mighty drum is powerful enough to be heard for miles. You need only strike it.* (node 6)
- Player: Hit the drum. (node 3)

context: Off-screen, a group of children recently burst into the area shouting that Helia, a nearby bear, has broken free and that the goblin guards in the pens were found slaughtered — containment and defenses around the pens have been breached. The large war drum in the camp is an alarm meant to summon or rally the camp; narration notes it sits silent but can be struck and heard for miles. If the player chooses the shown option to "Hit the drum," that will sound the alarm and cause the first half of the camp to become hostile. The short samples simply show the drum description followed by the player's decision to strike it.
